title: Pop-up restricted area (VIP visit)
description: A VIP visit to the Academic Area: a temporary flight restriction over the Academic Area and LHC roads is announced at 60 s and active from 70 s to 180 s. Drones inside are rerouted out or land, new routes plan around it, and departures from the LHC and Academic Area pads are held until it is lifted.
timeline: TFR VIP announced (dashed): Academic Area + LHC, 70–180 s
Active: reroute out / land; departures at V5, V7 held
